dogecoin.text: Like no sorry the memes and doge coin have made shibas so popular we have an over demand for the breed so we get puppy mills and backyard breeders who do not care and are not preservation breeders and only want the money

we are eating out today and this lady came up to me and asked if our dogs are "shibu inus" and if I was into doge coin (pronounced like doja cat). I said yeah they are shibas but I don't like crypto and she had the gall to say doge coin was important for shibas
